segments: The adoption of sons. See

entries.title: Galatians 4:8
segments: In bondage to them that by nature are no gods. That is, the Galatians were formerly idolaters.

entries.title: Galatians 4:9
segments: Rudiments. Jewish laws and ceremonies which were but symbols of the gospel revealed in Jesus Christ, through which they were to know God as Father, and be known by Him as sons.  The turning back to exalt mere forms was idolatry.  See note of

entries.title: Galatians 4:10
segments: Ye observe days, etc.  The Jews held certain days sacred to certain feasts and festivals.  See

entries.title: Galatians 4:11
segments: I am afraid of you. The expression is one of anxiety, not of fear.

entries.title: Galatians 4:12
segments: Become as I am. Although a Hebrew of the Hebrews (
), Paul knew that in Christ he was free of the old Jewish law.  His remonstrance is the more pointed to the Galatians who had never been under the law.

entries.title: Galatians 4:13
segments: An infirmity of the flesh. This is understood to refer to an illness of Paul's, which was a temptation (
) to the Galatians to despise him who had wrought miracles of healing upon others, yet seemed unable to heal himself (

).
 

 
 Received me as an angel.  Compare

entries.title: Galatians 4:17
segments: They desire to shut you out. The Judaizers, by insisting upon conformity to Jewish rites and observances, aimed to shut out the whole body of Gentile believers.

entries.title: Galatians 4:19
segments:
My little children.  This expression is one used often by John.  Paul's use of it here expresses unusual tenderness.
 

 
 In travail. In agonizing anxiety.

entries.title: Galatians 4:27
segments:
Thou barren. Sarah, who became the mother of Isaac, the child of promise.
 

 
 More are the children. They include all nations.  In the allegory the son of the bondwoman represents the bondage of the law; the son of the freewoman the freedom which comes by faith.  See

entries.title: Galatians 4:30
segments: Shall not inherit. The children of the flesh, and thereby under bondage of the law, shall not inherit with the children of the gospel, free of the law by righteousness through faith.
